title: AI Security and Innovation Act
last_action: House Science favorably reported the bill 29–0 after adopting a substitute and amendments concerning agentic AI, explainability/interpretability, and autonomous AI. CBO later issued an estimate.
summary: Establishes a NIST AI security and innovation center to measure national- and economic-security risks, conduct or facilitate evaluations, support R&D and standards, and collaborate voluntarily with industry.
committee_dynamics: The sponsor chairs the House Science AI-focused subcommittee, and the bill received unanimous committee support. Its principal vulnerability is implementation funding rather than committee opposition.
advance_rationale: Unanimous committee action, bipartisan amendments, leadership sponsorship, and a completed CBO estimate signal unusually mature floor preparation.
verification_level: Primary-source verified in the September 1, 2026 research pass
